explication: This repository builds Project V geosite routing data from domain-list files. The principal workflow is to select a data directory, load its lists, expand inclusions, convert entries to GeoSite protobuf records, and write `dlc.dat`. The implementation is concentrated in `main.go`; the README documents the list syntax, attributes, and intended routing use. Source evidence is limited to the excerpted `main.go` and README.
